character.name: Tea-Time Mouse
character.description: tiny warm-grey mouse with oversized pink ears and bright curious eyes, actively holding the handle of a large ivory teacup decorated with blue flowers, feet tucked up, teacup handle securely connects to the upper cord

style: Classic hand-drawn 2D theatrical cartoon style, expressive exaggerated poses, squash-and-stretch animation aesthetics, bold clean outlines, vintage cel shading, playful slapstick character design.
